findings.source_quote: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind –2 Timothy 1:4-7.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Portuguese rendering of "sound mind" (sã mente / espírito sóbrio) rather than "moderação", which can be ambiguous. For example: "mas de poder, de amor e de uma sã mente –2 Timóteo 1:4-7." Preserve existing tags and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Porque Deus não nos deu o espírito de temor, mas de poder, de amor e de moderação –2 Timóteo 1:4-7.

findings.source_quote: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial –Matthew 26:12.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the archaic spelling "ungüento" to the current standard Portuguese spelling ("unguento" or better: "unguento" is acceptable). Make no other alterations to wording or tags.
findings.translation_quote: Jesus lhes disse: Porque, deixando isto, ela o fez para sepultura de mim –Mateus 26:12. (context uses 'ungüento' earlier in the paragraph)

findings.location: source.html — paragraphs using the English loanword "stress"
findings.source_quote: Stress and anxiety will melt away in the presence of Jesus.
findings.suggested_fix: Prefer the standard Portuguese term "estresse" (or 'tensão/ansiedade') instead of the English loanword "Stress" for consistency and clarity. E.g.: "O estresse e a ansiedade desaparecerão na presença de Jesus." Keep existing HTML structure.
findings.translation_quote: Stress e ansiedade se dissiparão na presença de Jesus. Deus fala conosco por Seu Espírito Santo através de Sua Palavra.
